name: Elemental Sense
description: Volcanic and frozen ground do not harm you.

name: Force Path
description: Open one impassable hex adjacent to the party: shatter a rockfall, freeze a crossing. The opened passage may be rough going.

name: Tremorsense
description: Shake the ground under a guard within 6 tiles. It holds only its own tile from then on, so you can slip past.

name: Ember Ward
description: Your next fight is fought under clear skies, whatever the weather.
